name: toram-online-auto-build-calculator
description: Toram Online auto build calculator desktop shell

scripts.items:test: node tools/tests/application/test-item-catalog.mjs && node tools/tests/application/test-item-equipment.mjs && node tools/tests/application/test-item-events.mjs && node tools/tests/application/test-crysta-catalog.mjs && node tools/tests/application/test-supplemental-stats.mjs && node tools/tests/application/test-option-event-calculator.mjs && node tools/tests/application/test-option-calculation-integration.mjs
scripts.verify:architecture: npm run types:emit && npm run types:check && node tools/verification/verify-typescript-boundaries.mjs && node tools/verification/verify-calculation-contracts.mjs && node tools/verification/verify-application-boundary.mjs && node tools/verification/verify-build-state.mjs && node tools/verification/verify-ui-boundaries.mjs && node tools/tests/application/test-build-setting-snapshot.mjs && node tools/tests/application/test-tauri-build-storage-adapter.mjs && node tools/verification/verify-storage-contract.mjs && node tools/verification/verify-optimization-execution.mjs && node tools/tests/optimization/test-crysta-execution-adapter.mjs && node tools/tests/optimization/test-crysta-recommendation-apply.mjs && node tools/verification/verify-native-boundaries.mjs && node tools/verification/verify-runtime-contracts.mjs && node tools/verification/verify-role-layout.mjs
scripts.web:build: npm run wasm:build && node tools/prepare-frontend.mjs web
scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run wasm:build && npm run types:emit && node tools/prepare-frontend.mjs desktop
scripts.desktop:clean: cargo clean --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml -p tauri -p tauri-plugin-updater -p toram-online-auto-build-calculator && cargo clean --release --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml -p tauri -p tauri-plugin-updater -p toram-online-auto-build-calculator && cargo clean --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml -p tauri -p tauri-plugin-updater -p toram-online-auto-build-calculator
scripts.test:regression:normal: npm run wasm:build && node tools/run-regression-suite.mjs normal
